Carries content: the body

WingFoil-Version: 0.3.1 (unknown)

Add spring campaign discount codes

SPRING10 takes 10 % off the items, rounded to the nearest cent with a
half cent up. WELCOME5 takes 5.00 € off items of 30.00 € or more. An
order takes one code at most, given with applyCode(orderNumber, code);
an unknown code or a WELCOME5 below its minimum is refused and leaves
the order as it was.

Totals now show discountCents, and totalCents is items minus discount
plus shipping. Shipping is still decided on the items before discount.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
